caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure, possibly a statue or a wooden carving, dressed in a long, flowing garment that extends to the feet. The garment is primarily off-white with grayish and blue tones and has red trimming at the outer edges. A decorative shawl or sash, featuring blue, red, and white colors with zigzag and scalloped patterns, is draped over the figure's left shoulder and arm, and falls down the front of the body and across the back. The figure’s hands are pressed together at chest level in a gesture of prayer or greeting. The face has large, dark eyes, arched eyebrows, and a subtle smile. The figure's hair is dark and combed back, with part of the scalp showing. The figure stands on a simple, rounded base rendered in muted brown and white tones. The background is plain and uncolored. In the lower right corner, the name "Mabel G. Claflin" is written in small greenish-blue script.
title: Immaculate Conception
